output_list.criticism: The function mint uses the variable numberOfTokenIds to generate the tokenId for the new hero instance. If the number of tokenIds exceeds the maximum value of uint256, an integer overflow error will occur.
The function addExp adds the input _exp to the current exp of the hero instance. If the sum of currentExp and _exp exceeds the maximum value of uint256, an integer overflow error will occur.

The function addDeposit adds the input _amount to the current deposit of the address _to. If the sum of addressToGoldDeposit[_to] and _amount exceeds the maximum value of uint256, an integer overflow error will occur.

The function levelUp increases the current level of the hero instance by 1 and updates the current stats. If the sum of _heroInstance.currentLevel and _heroInstance.ivForStats[i] exceeds the maximum value of uint256, an integer overflow error will occur.

The function transferDeposit transfers the input _amount from the sender to the contract. If the sum of addressToGoldDeposit[msg.sender] and _amount exceeds the maximum value of uint256, an integer overflow error will occur.
